signature: function_spans(proj_dir: str, filepath: str) -> list[tuple[str, int, int]] | None
pre_condition: proj_dir is a path to a valid project directory. filepath is a path to a Rust source file within the project.
post_condition: If CodeGraph is initialized for the project, returns a list of (function_name, start_line, end_line) tuples for all functions found in the given Rust source file, where start_line and end_line are 0-indexed and inclusive. Returns None if CodeGraph could not be initialized, signaling the caller to fall back to regex-based extraction. When a list is returned, it may be empty if the file contains no detectable functions.
